CustomField.label: Potential Duplicate ID
CustomField.description: Stores the Salesforce ID of a suspected duplicate Opportunity record. Set by the Data Quality Agent when an employee flags a potential duplicate pair for admin review.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The 18-character Salesforce record ID of the Opportunity suspected to be a duplicate of this one. Populated by the Duplicate Flagging Agent — do not edit manually.
